ModuleChannel1.English: Ground references use mixed grid phases without a captured footprint. Capture this module from the map again.
ModuleChannel1.Chinese: 模块没有截取占地记录，地面引用的网格相位不一致。请从原地图重新截取该模块。

ModuleChannel2.English: This block is too large. Add cuts before saving.
ModuleChannel2.Chinese: 此块超过大小限制，请继续切分后入库。

ModuleChannel3.English: Cuts must preserve the two-cell ground grid and leave at least two cells on each side.
ModuleChannel3.Chinese: 切线须对齐两格地面网格，且两侧各保留至少两格。

ModuleChannel4.English: The partition must cover the entire map without gaps.
ModuleChannel4.Chinese: 分区必须完整覆盖地图，不能留空隙。

ModuleChannel5.English: This cut crosses a protected region. Move the cut or remove the protection.
ModuleChannel5.Chinese: 切线穿过保护区域，请移动切线或移除保护。

ModuleChannel6.English: Select two adjacent blocks whose union is a rectangle; no other block may be included.
ModuleChannel6.Chinese: 请选择合并后仍为矩形的两个相邻模块，不能包含其他模块。

ModuleChannel20.English: Click or drag inside a block to place a cut. Orange is a draft; red explains a rejected cut. Esc cancels.
ModuleChannel20.Chinese: 在模块内点击或拖动放置切线。橙色为草稿，红色表示操作无效；按 Esc 取消。

ModuleChannel21.English: Drag a complete shared edge between two blocks. T-junction edges must be merged first.
ModuleChannel21.Chinese: 拖动两个模块之间的完整公共边界。T 形交接边界须先合并后再调整。

ModuleChannel22.English: Click two adjacent blocks to merge their rectangular union.
ModuleChannel22.Chinese: 依次点击两个相邻模块，合并为完整矩形。

ModuleChannel23.English: Drag a protected rectangle. Automatic and manual cuts will avoid it. Esc cancels.
ModuleChannel23.Chinese: 拖动框选保护区域，自动及手动切线均避开此区域。按 Esc 取消。

ModuleChannel24.English: Click a block to inspect it; checkboxes choose what to save. Green is the main passage, orange marks other regions; blank cells may be passable.
ModuleChannel24.Chinese: 点击模块查看，勾选决定入库。绿色为主通路，橙色标记其他通路；空白格也可能可通行。

ModuleChannel25.English: Preview is out of date. Re-run the split before editing or saving.
ModuleChannel25.Chinese: 预览已过期，请重新拆分后再编辑或入库。

ModuleChannel26.English: Existing cuts cross a protected region. Merge the affected blocks or preview the split again.
ModuleChannel26.Chinese: 已有切线穿过保护区域，请合并相关模块或重新预览拆分。

ModuleChannel27.English: The grid crosses a protected region. Use corridor mode or change the block dimensions.
ModuleChannel27.Chinese: 网格穿过保护区域，请改用按通道拆分或调整分块尺寸。

ModuleChannel28.English: Preview even-sized blocks. Connections are paired across shared passable edges; empty or disconnected blocks are excluded. Choose fixed blocks or corridor-aware cuts, then inspect and adjust the candidates.
ModuleChannel28.Chinese: 尺寸以格为单位，须填写偶数；按通道拆分时仅作大小参考。接口在共享通路两侧成对生成，可预览并调整候选模块；空白或断连块不可入库。

ModuleSplitEvenDimensions.English: Use even block dimensions from 4 to 512 cells.
ModuleSplitEvenDimensions.Chinese: 分块宽高须为 4～512 的偶数。

ModuleSplitMapLimit.English: Split maps of at least 2 × 2 and at most 4,000,000 cells.
ModuleSplitMapLimit.Chinese: 可拆分至少 2 × 2、总格数不超过 400 万的地图。

ModuleSplitCountLimit.English: The split would exceed 256 blocks. Increase the block dimensions.
ModuleSplitCountLimit.Chinese: 拆分结果超过 256 块，请增大分块宽高。

ModuleSplitEmpty.English: Empty block; excluded from the module pool.

ModuleSplitNoSeam.English: No usable connection to another valid block. Adjust the block dimensions.
ModuleSplitNoSeam.Chinese: 没有通向其他有效分块的可用接口，请调整分块宽高。

ModuleSplitGenerate.English: Save and generate a new map

ModuleSplitHelp.English: Preview even-sized blocks. Connections are paired across shared passable edges; empty or disconnected blocks are excluded. This is a grid split, not room recognition.
ModuleSplitHelp.Chinese: 按偶数宽高分块，共享可通行边界的接口成对生成。空白或内部不连通的块不可入库。当前按网格拆分，不识别房间结构。

ModuleSplitStale.English: Block dimensions changed. Preview the split again before saving.
ModuleSplitStale.Chinese: 分块尺寸已改变，请重新预览后再入库。

ModuleSplitPrefixLimit.English: Enter a module name prefix of 1–96 characters.
ModuleSplitPrefixLimit.Chinese: 请填写 1～96 个字符的模块名称前缀。

ModuleSplitPreviewFirst.English: Preview the split before saving modules.
ModuleSplitPreviewFirst.Chinese: 请先预览拆分结果，再保存模块。

ModuleSplitSummary.Chinese: 共 {0} 块，可用 {1} 块，已选 {2} 块。

ModuleSplitMatchRequired.English: Select modules with matching opposite connections to generate a map.
ModuleSplitMatchRequired.Chinese: 请选中含相对匹配接口的模块，再随机生成地图。

ModuleBatchSaveCount.English: Select between 1 and 256 modules for saving.
ModuleBatchSaveCount.Chinese: 请选择 1～256 个模块入库。

ModuleSplitSaved.Chinese: 已从地图拆分并入库 {0} 个模块。

ModuleReferenceHint.English: Map size is estimated from module footprints and count. These dimensions are a reference; the generator adjusts them as needed, up to 4096 per side and 1,000,000 cells. The original map is preserved.
ModuleReferenceHint.Chinese: 根据模块占地与数量估算新地图大小。宽高仅作参考，程序按需调整；最终单边不超过 4096，总格数不超过 100 万。保留原地图。

ModuleReferencePositive.English: Enter positive whole numbers for the reference width and height.
ModuleReferencePositive.Chinese: 参考宽度和高度须填写正整数。

ModuleInstanceCount.English: Enter 2–128 placed module instances. One selected module type can be reused.
ModuleInstanceCount.Chinese: 生成数量须为 2～128 个实例，不是勾选的模块种类数；只选一种模块也可以重复生成。

ModuleValidSearchOptions.English: Choose a valid layout and search limit.
ModuleValidSearchOptions.Chinese: 请选择有效的布局方式和搜索次数上限。

ModuleAutomaticCapacity.English: Even the smallest module needs at least {0} footprint cells for {1} instances, exceeding the 1,000,000-cell limit. Reduce the count or use smaller modules.
ModuleAutomaticCapacity.Chinese: 即使全部采用最小模块，生成 {1} 个实例也至少需要 {0} 格占地，超过 100 万格上限。请减少数量或使用更小的模块。

ModuleAutomaticLimit.English: Tried {0} map sizes for {1} modules (best attempt: {2}), within 4096 per side and 1,000,000 cells. This bounded search does not prove no layout exists. Try fewer modules, another seed or compatible connections.
ModuleAutomaticLimit.Chinese: 已在单边 4096、总格数 100 万的限制内尝试 {0} 种地图尺寸。目标 {1} 个模块，最佳尝试 {2} 个；本轮搜索未找到完整布局，不代表绝对无解。请减少数量、更换种子或调整匹配接口。

ModuleAutomaticTrying.English: Trying a {0} × {1} new map based on module footprints…
ModuleAutomaticTrying.Chinese: 正在根据模块占地尝试 {0} × {1} 的新地图……

ModuleUXMapTab.English: Open a map tab to work with modules.
ModuleUXMapTab.Chinese: 请先切换到普通地图标签页，再使用模块功能。

ModuleUXLibraries.English: Load game libraries in Settings before generating a module map.
ModuleUXLibraries.Chinese: 请先在设置中加载游戏素材库，再生成模块地图。

ModuleUXEdgeError.English: Connection {0}: place the full opening on its boundary, with room for the inward cell.
ModuleUXEdgeError.Chinese: 接口 {0} 必须完整位于对应边界上，且向内一格不能越界。

ModuleUXOverlapError.English: Connection {0} overlaps another enabled connection at ({1}, {2}).
ModuleUXOverlapError.Chinese: 接口 {0} 在 ({1}, {2}) 与另一个已启用接口重叠。

ModuleUXBlockedError.English: Connection {0} is blocked at ({1}, {2}). Move the opening or repair the map collision.
ModuleUXBlockedError.Chinese: 接口 {0} 在 ({1}, {2}) 遇到碰撞阻挡。请移动接口，或返回地图修正碰撞。

ModuleUXNoEnabled.English: Enable at least one connection before saving a module.
ModuleUXNoEnabled.Chinese: 保存模块前至少启用一个连接点。

ModuleUXList.English: Connections · check to enable, click to edit
ModuleUXList.Chinese: 连接点：勾选启用，点击条目编辑

ModuleUXNavigation.English: Wheel: zoom · Middle/Space: pan · Esc: cancel draft · Delete: remove · Ctrl+Z/Y: undo/redo
ModuleUXNavigation.Chinese: 滚轮缩放 · 中键／空格拖动画布 · Esc 取消草稿 · Delete 删除 · Ctrl+Z/Y 撤销／重做

ModuleUXLegend.English: Green: enabled · Cyan + handles: selected · Dashed orange: draft · Red: invalid · Dashed grey: disabled
ModuleUXLegend.Chinese: 绿色：启用；青色及端点：选中；橙色虚线：草稿；红色：非法；灰色虚线：未启用。

ModuleUXBoundary.English: Place the connection on the module boundary.
ModuleUXBoundary.Chinese: 请把连接点放在模块边界上。

ModuleUXPlace.English: Click or drag along a boundary to place a connection. Esc cancels.
ModuleUXPlace.Chinese: 点击边界放置一格连接点，沿边界拖动设置宽度。Esc 取消。

ModuleUXEditing.English: Editing {0}. Drag its body to move or its handles to resize.
ModuleUXEditing.Chinese: 正在编辑 {0}。拖动主体移动，拖动端点调整宽度。

ModuleUXSelect.English: Select a connection on the map or in the list.
ModuleUXSelect.Chinese: 在画布或列表中选择连接点。

ModuleUXSuggestions.English: Detected openings are suggestions based on collision data. Empty cells are walkable; disabling an opening does not build a wall.
ModuleUXSuggestions.Chinese: 识别结果是根据碰撞数据提出的接口建议。空白格视为可通行；取消启用不会自动补墙。

ModuleUXFinish.English: Finish or cancel the current connection edit before saving.
ModuleUXFinish.Chinese: 请先完成或取消当前连接点编辑，再保存。

ModuleUXApply.English: Apply connections, then save the object to use it in map generation.
ModuleUXApply.Chinese: 应用连接点后，保存对象即可用于生成模块地图。

ModuleUXSearch.English: Search name, tag or connection type
ModuleUXSearch.Chinese: 搜索名称、标签或接口类型

ModuleNewMapHint.English: Generate on a new blank map. The current map and selection are preserved. Choose dimensions from 16 to 4096, up to 1,000,000 cells.
ModuleNewMapHint.Chinese: 在独立空白地图上生成，保留当前地图及选区。新地图宽高为 16～4096，总格数不超过 100 万。

ModuleNewMapLimit.English: Module generation supports up to 1,000,000 cells. Choose a smaller new map.
ModuleNewMapLimit.Chinese: 模块生成支持最多 100 万格，请缩小新地图尺寸。

ModuleUXReady.English: Preview ready · click a module to inspect its connections.
ModuleUXReady.Chinese: 预览已就绪，点击模块查看来源及接口。

ModuleUXRunning.English: Generating… Previous preview is for reference only.
ModuleUXRunning.Chinese: 正在生成……旧预览仅供参考。

ModuleUXStale.English: Parameters changed. Generate again before applying.
ModuleUXStale.Chinese: 参数已改变，请重新生成后再应用。

ModuleUXFailed.English: Generation failed. Previous preview is for reference only.
ModuleUXFailed.Chinese: 生成失败。旧预览仅供参考，不能应用。

ModuleCaptureSize.English: Selection: {0} × {1} cells. Empty margins are preserved.
ModuleCaptureSize.Chinese: 选区：{0} × {1} 格。保留边缘空白格。

ModuleCaptureReady.English: The module is connected and ready to save. It will appear in automatic generation after saving.
ModuleCaptureReady.Chinese: 模块内部连通，可以保存。入库后可在自动生成模块地图中选择。

ModuleCaptureSelect.English: Press M and drag a rectangular map selection, then use Tools → Create module from selection.
ModuleCaptureSelect.Chinese: 按 M 切换选择工具，拖出矩形选区，再点击“工具 → 从选区生成模块”。

ModuleCaptureSaved.English: Module saved. Use Tools → Generate modules automatically to create a new map.
ModuleCaptureSaved.Chinese: 模块已入库。点击“工具 → 自动生成模块地图”创建新地图。

ModuleCaptureEmptyPool.English: No modules yet. Select a map region and use Tools → Create module from selection.
ModuleCaptureEmptyPool.Chinese: 尚无可用模块。请先框选地图区域，再点击“工具 → 从选区生成模块”制作。

ModuleCaptureInvalidArea.English: Select a rectangle at least 2 × 2 and at most 1,000,000 cells inside the map.
ModuleCaptureInvalidArea.Chinese: 请在地图内选择至少 2 × 2 格、最多 100 万格的矩形区域，单边不超过 4096 格。

ModuleCaptureInvalidName.English: Enter a module name of 1–128 characters without control characters.
ModuleCaptureInvalidName.Chinese: 请输入 1～128 个字符的模块名称，不可包含控制字符。

ModuleCaptureCatalogueChanged.English: The catalogue changed during module saving. Open the preview again.
ModuleCaptureCatalogueChanged.Chinese: 保存时素材目录发生变化，请重新打开模块预览。

ModuleGenerationOptions.English: The generation area must be inside the target map, at least 2 × 2 and at most 1,000,000 cells.
ModuleGenerationOptions.Chinese: 生成区域必须位于目标地图内，至少为 2 × 2，且不超过 100 万格。

ModuleGenerationPoolLimit.English: Select between 1 and 256 modules for automatic generation.
ModuleGenerationPoolLimit.Chinese: 请勾选 1～256 种模块参与自动生成。

ModuleGenerationPoolSize.English: The selected module pool is too large. Select fewer modules.
ModuleGenerationPoolSize.Chinese: 所选模块素材范围过大，请减少参与生成的模块种类。

ModuleGenerationSearchFailed.English: Could not generate {0} connected modules (best attempt: {1}). Try a larger area, fewer modules, another seed or more matching modules.
ModuleGenerationSearchFailed.Chinese: 本轮未能生成 {0} 个连通模块（最佳尝试为 {1} 个，不代表绝对无解）。请扩大区域、减少数量、更换种子或添加更多接口匹配的模块。

ModuleGenerationNoMatchingPorts.English: Cannot connect the selected modules: no pair has opposite directions, the same type and equal width. Target: {0}; only one module can be placed. Edit connections or select compatible modules; changing the seed will not help.
ModuleGenerationNoMatchingPorts.Chinese: 所选模块没有方向相反、类型相同且宽度相等的接口对，无法连接。目标 {0} 个，目前只能放置单个模块。请编辑连接点或选择接口匹配的模块；更换种子无法解决。

ModuleGenerationSearchLimit.English: Search limit reached for {0} modules (best attempt: {1}). This does not prove no layout exists. Try an empty area, fewer modules or another seed.
ModuleGenerationSearchLimit.Chinese: 生成 {0} 个模块时达到本轮搜索次数上限（最佳尝试 {1} 个），不代表绝对无解。请尝试空白区域、减少数量或更换种子。

ModuleGenerationAreaSize.English: No module fits the {0} × {1} generation area. Module sizes: {2}. Expand the area or select smaller modules; reducing the count will not help.
ModuleGenerationAreaSize.Chinese: 生成区域 {0} × {1} 放不下任何一个模块。模块尺寸：{2}。请扩大区域或选择较小模块；仅减少数量无法解决。

ModuleGenerationGroundAlignment.English: No first module can align its ground tiles inside this area. Expand the area or shift its origin by one cell.
ModuleGenerationGroundAlignment.Chinese: 首个模块的地面格子无法在当前区域内对齐。请扩大区域，或将区域起点平移一格。

ModuleGenerationAreaOccupied.English: No first module fits an empty footprint in area ({0}, {1}), {2} × {3}; {4} cells contain map content. Ground, objects and collision flags all count as occupied. Use a blank map or an empty region, not the source selection used to capture modules.
ModuleGenerationAreaOccupied.Chinese: 区域 ({0}, {1})、大小 {2} × {3} 内没有能容纳首个模块的完整空白占地，其中 {4} 格已有地图内容。地面、对象及碰撞标记均算占用。请使用空白地图或空白区域，不要在截取模块的原选区内生成。

ModuleGenerationInterior.English: All walkable cells and connections inside a module must be connected without leaving its footprint.
ModuleGenerationInterior.Chinese: 模块内部所有可行走格和连接点必须连通，且不能通过模块外部绕路。

ModuleGenerationDisconnected.English: The generated modules are not fully connected.
ModuleGenerationDisconnected.Chinese: 生成结果中的模块未能整体连通。

ModuleGenerationPool.Chinese: 参与生成的模块（允许重复使用）

ModuleGenerationHelp.English: The generator chooses modules and connections automatically. Chain extends the latest module; Branching spreads outward from the start; Compact prefers nearby connections. Only empty footprints are used.
ModuleGenerationHelp.Chinese: 程序自动选择模块和连接点。链式沿最新模块继续扩展；分支从起点向外逐层展开；紧凑优先连接附近接口。只在空白占地中放置模块。

ModuleGenerationNumbers.English: Enter whole numbers for module count, seed and reference dimensions.
ModuleGenerationNumbers.Chinese: 模块数量、随机种子及参考宽高均须填写整数。

ModuleGenerationWorking.Chinese: 正在自动选取并连接模块……

ModuleGenerationReady.English: Generated {0} modules and {1} connections. All {2} walkable cells are connected. Seed: {3}. Ctrl+Z undoes the whole layout.
ModuleGenerationReady.Chinese: 已生成 {0} 个模块、{1} 处连接，全部 {2} 个可行走格整体连通。种子：{3}。Ctrl+Z 可整体撤销。

ModuleGenerationCancelled.English: Generation cancelled. The map was not changed.
ModuleGenerationCancelled.Chinese: 已停止生成，地图未被修改。

ModuleGenerationApplied.English: Created a new map with {0} connected modules. Ctrl+Z to undo the layout.
ModuleGenerationApplied.Chinese: 已创建包含 {0} 个连通模块的新地图，可按 Ctrl+Z 整体撤销布局。

DimensionsTotalLimit.English: Use dimensions from 16 to 4096, with at most 16,000,000 cells.
DimensionsTotalLimit.Chinese: 宽高须为 16～4096，且总格数不能超过 1600 万。

MixedUnchanged.Chinese: 混合值 — 留空不修改

RecoveryWriteFailed.English: Could not write the automatic recovery snapshot.
RecoveryWriteFailed.Chinese: 自动恢复快照写入失败。

MapChangedCheckAgain.English: The map changed. Run the check again.
MapChangedCheckAgain.Chinese: 地图已发生变化，请重新检查。

MapCheckSummary.English: {0:N0} findings; showing {1:N0}. Disconnected areas may be intentional.
MapCheckSummary.Chinese: 发现 {0:N0} 项，显示 {1:N0} 项。独立区域可能是有意设计，请人工复核。

LoadLibrariesForCheck.English: Load libraries to check image references.
LoadLibrariesForCheck.Chinese: 加载资源库后可检查图像引用。

DoorNoForeground.Chinese: 门属性没有对应的前景图像

DoorNoNeighbour.English: Door has no walkable neighbouring cell
DoorNoNeighbour.Chinese: 门周围没有可行走单元格

DisconnectedArea.Chinese: 独立可行走区域：{0:N0} 格

UnlockAllLayers.English: Unlock all layers before editing multiple layers.
UnlockAllLayers.Chinese: 请先解锁所有图层，再执行跨图层操作。

AiRoleHint_20261105.English: Configure vision, image generation and chat independently. Object recognition uses Vision AI.
AiRoleHint_20261105.Chinese: 视觉识图、生图和对话分别设置。物体识别使用视觉识图 AI。

AiDefaultPath_20261105.English: Leave empty to use the provider default path
AiDefaultPath_20261105.Chinese: 留空使用服务商默认路径

AiExtra_20261105.Chinese: 附加 JSON / 自定义请求模板

AiSize_20261105.Chinese: 图片尺寸格式（x / 星号 / 总像素）

AiTemplates_20261105.English: Templates: {{model}}, {{prompt}}, {{system}}, {{image}}, {{images}}, {{width}}, {{height}}, {{size}}, {{n}}. Custom providers replace the request body; other providers merge extra JSON.
AiTemplates_20261105.Chinese: 模板变量：{{model}}、{{prompt}}、{{system}}、{{image}}、{{images}}、{{width}}、{{height}}、{{size}}、{{n}}。自定义服务使用完整请求模板，其他服务合并附加 JSON。

AiTestImage_20261105.Chinese: 测试生图（会生成一张图片）

AiTesting_20261105.Chinese: 正在测试 AI 请求…

AiCorrectAll_20261105.Chinese: AI 识别并筛选全部未审核

AiCorrectHint_20261105.English: Uses Vision AI from Settings. Incomplete objects are excluded; uncertain results remain for review. Undo restores the whole batch.
AiCorrectHint_20261105.Chinese: 使用设置中的视觉识图 AI。不完整物件会被剔除，不确定的保留待审核；撤销可恢复整批结果。

AiSelect_20261105.English: Select candidates for AI recognition first.
AiSelect_20261105.Chinese: 请先选择需要 AI 识别的候选物体。

AiRecognized_20261105.English: AI checked {0} objects: {1} incomplete excluded, {2} uncertain kept. Review remaining objects before saving; Undo restores the whole batch.
AiRecognized_20261105.Chinese: AI 已检查 {0} 个物件：剔除 {1} 个不完整物件，保留 {2} 个不确定项。其余结果请审核后保存；撤销可恢复整批结果。

AiRecognitionCancelled_20261105.Chinese: AI 识别已取消，候选结果未更改。

AiRecognitionFailed_20261105.Chinese: AI 识别失败，候选结果未更改。{0}

AiRecognitionJson_20261105.English: AI did not return valid object recognition JSON.
AiRecognitionJson_20261105.Chinese: AI 未返回有效的物体识别 JSON。

AiRecognitionInvalid_20261105.English: AI returned an invalid object name or category. Please retry.
AiRecognitionInvalid_20261105.Chinese: AI 返回的物体名称或分类无效，请重试。

AiCompletenessInvalid_20261106.English: AI did not return a valid completeness decision. Please retry.
AiCompletenessInvalid_20261106.Chinese: AI 未返回有效的完整性判定，请重试。

AiInvalidRole_20261105.English: This provider does not support the selected AI role.
AiInvalidRole_20261105.Chinese: 此服务商不支持所选 AI 用途。

AiInvalidUrl_20261105.English: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS AI service address.
AiInvalidUrl_20261105.Chinese: 请填写有效的 HTTP 或 HTTPS AI 接口地址。

AiInvalidModel_20261105.Chinese: 请填写 AI 模型名称。

AiInvalidTimeout_20261105.English: AI timeout must be between 1 and 1800 seconds.
AiInvalidTimeout_20261105.Chinese: AI 超时时间须为 1 至 1800 秒。

AiInvalidAuth_20261105.Chinese: 未知的 AI 鉴权方式。

AiInvalidExtra_20261105.English: AI extra body must be a JSON object.
AiInvalidExtra_20261105.Chinese: AI 附加参数 / 模板必须为有效的 JSON 对象。

AiMissingTextPath_20261105.English: AI response path did not contain text.
AiMissingTextPath_20261105.Chinese: AI 响应字段路径中未找到文本。

AiMissingText_20261105.English: AI returned no text. Check the model and response path.
AiMissingText_20261105.Chinese: AI 未返回文本，请检查模型和响应字段路径。

AiMissingTask_20261105.English: DashScope did not return a task ID.

AlienThemeDescription.Chinese: 偏心环坑、断裂通道、异形晶体生态

ClassicThemeDescription.Chinese: 经典房间与自然洞穴布局

ThemeObjectsUnavailable.English: No reviewed visible objects are available for this dungeon theme.
ThemeObjectsUnavailable.Chinese: 当前素材库没有此主题所需的已审查可见物件。

ExpandMapHint.English: Add blank cells on each side in steps of 2. Existing artwork is preserved.
ExpandMapHint.Chinese: 按 2 格为单位向四边增加空白区域，保留原有地图内容。

InvalidExpansion.English: Enter non-negative even amounts, with at least one side greater than 0. The result must fit the map size limits.
InvalidExpansion.Chinese: 请输入非负偶数，至少一侧大于 0，扩边结果不能超出地图尺寸限制。

EyedropperToolHint.English: Click a ground or middle tile to select its source artwork.
EyedropperToolHint.Chinese: 点击地砖或中间层素材，拾取对应素材并在素材列表中定位。

PanToolHint.English: Drag with the left mouse button to pan. Middle drag and Space + drag also work.
PanToolHint.Chinese: 按住鼠标左键拖动画布；也支持中键拖动和空格加拖动。

CropSelectionHint.English: Keep the selected map area. Edges align outward to 2×2 ground tiles. Undo is supported.
CropSelectionHint.Chinese: 保留所选地图范围，边界向外对齐 2×2 地砖。支持撤销。

MinimapInvalidDimensions.English: Enter positive whole-number dimensions. If the image is too large, reduce its width or height.
MinimapInvalidDimensions.Chinese: 宽高请输入正整数；若图像尺寸过大，请减小宽度或高度。

QuickMapFolderIsFile.English: The output folder or one of its parents is a file. Choose another folder.
QuickMapFolderIsFile.Chinese: 输出目录或它的某个上级路径是文件，请选择其他目录。

GeneratorMapInfo.English: {0} × {1} cells · Changes apply only after confirmation.
GeneratorMapInfo.Chinese: {0} × {1} 单元格 · 确认后才会应用生成结果。

GeneratorChangeSeedHelp.English: Change only the seed, keeping other settings. The overall layout may change.
GeneratorChangeSeedHelp.Chinese: 仅更换种子，保留其他参数；整体布局可能改变。

GeneratorRandomizeSettingsHelp.English: Randomize generator settings and the seed.
GeneratorRandomizeSettingsHelp.Chinese: 随机调整生成参数及种子。

GeneratorCentreDetailHelp.English: Show a fixed crop at the map centre. Turn this off to navigate the full preview.
GeneratorCentreDetailHelp.Chinese: 显示地图中心的固定裁切区域；取消勾选可浏览整图预览。

GeneratorDungeonDetailHelp.English: Show a fixed crop around the first room. Turn this off to navigate the full preview.
GeneratorDungeonDetailHelp.Chinese: 显示首个房间附近的固定裁切区域；取消勾选可浏览整图预览。

GeneratorFitPreviewHelp.English: Fit the preview to the window
GeneratorFitPreviewHelp.Chinese: 恢复整张预览，适应当前窗口

GeneratorNavigationHint.Chinese: 滚轮缩放 · 拖动平移

GeneratorZoomHelp.English: Zoom is relative to fit and only affects the preview, not the map.
GeneratorZoomHelp.Chinese: 缩放比例以适应窗口为基准，仅改变预览，不改变地图尺寸。

GeneratorExactValueHelp.English: Enter an exact value; the slider's range and steps still apply.
GeneratorExactValueHelp.Chinese: 可直接输入精确数值，仍遵循原滑块的范围和档位。

ModuleConnectionNumbers.English: Enter integer coordinates and an opening width.
ModuleConnectionNumbers.Chinese: 请输入整数坐标和通路宽度。

ModuleConnectionEmpty.English: Paint a module before defining connections.
ModuleConnectionEmpty.Chinese: 请先绘制模块内容，再定义连接点。

ModuleConnectionBounds.English: Module bounds exceed the editor limit.
ModuleConnectionBounds.Chinese: 模块范围超出编辑器限制。

ModuleConnectionLimit.English: Unsupported connections or more than 64 openings.
ModuleConnectionLimit.Chinese: 连接点格式不受支持，或开口数量超过 64。

ModuleConnectionFields.English: Use unique connection IDs, valid types and widths from 1 to 64.
ModuleConnectionFields.Chinese: 请使用不重复的连接点编号、有效类型及 1～64 的通路宽度。

ModuleJoinSaveFirst.English: Save module connections before joining modules.
ModuleJoinSaveFirst.Chinese: 请先为对象定义连接点并保存，再进行模块拼接。

ModuleJoinMismatch.English: Choose opposite connections with the same type and width.
ModuleJoinMismatch.Chinese: 请选择方向相对、类型及宽度一致的连接点。

ModuleJoinBoundary.English: Joined modules extend outside the map.
ModuleJoinBoundary.Chinese: 拼接后的模块超出地图边界。

ModuleJoinLimit.English: Preview at most 1,000,000 module cells at once.
ModuleJoinLimit.Chinese: 单次拼接预览最多支持 1,000,000 个模块占地单元格。

ModuleJoinGround.English: The connection would misalign ground tiles. Use even ground coordinates and compatible module sizes.
ModuleJoinGround.Chinese: 此连接会导致地面素材错位，请使用偶数地面坐标及尺寸兼容的模块。

ModuleJoinOccupied.English: Module footprint contains existing content at ({0}, {1}). Choose an empty area.
ModuleJoinOccupied.Chinese: 模块占地内的 ({0}, {1}) 已有内容，请选择空白区域。

ModuleJoinBlocked.Chinese: 拼接后的接缝通路被阻塞。

ModuleJoinStale.English: The map changed after the module preview. Generate a fresh preview.
ModuleJoinStale.Chinese: 地图已在预览后发生变化，请重新生成拼接预览。

ModuleJoinPreviewRequired.Chinese: 请先生成预览，再应用到地图。

ModuleJoinInstances.Chinese: 地图中的对象实例数量已达上限。

SetModels_NoSetFiles.English: No .set files found. Choose a game folder containing Data and Map.
SetModels_NoSetFiles.Chinese: 未找到 .set 文件。请选择包含 Data 和 Map 的游戏目录。

SetModels_Loaded.Chinese: 已从 {1} 读取 {0:N0} 个组合模型 · {2:N0} 个部件 · 绑定：{3}

SetModels_LoadLibs.English: Load game libraries in Settings to preview compositions.
SetModels_LoadLibs.Chinese: 请先在设置中加载游戏资源库以预览组合模型。

SetModels_NoImages.English: No resolvable images in this composition.
SetModels_NoImages.Chinese: 此组合模型没有可解析的图片。

SetModels_Placed.English: Composition placed as a stamp: {0} cells (pixel offsets folded onto the 48×32 grid)
SetModels_Placed.Chinese: 已放置为印章：{0} 格（像素偏移按 48×32 网格近似折算）

SetModels_PiecesOffsets.Chinese: {0:N0} 个部件 · {1:N0} 个含图 · 偏移范围 {2}×{3}px

SetModels_ExportPngTitle.English: Choose a folder for PNG export
SetModels_ExportPngTitle.Chinese: 选择 PNG 导出文件夹

SetModels_Exporting.Chinese: 正在将组合模型导出为 PNG…

SetModels_Exported.Chinese: 已导出 {0:N0} 张 PNG 到 {1}

SetModels_ExportNoLibs.English: Load game libraries in Settings before exporting compositions.
SetModels_ExportNoLibs.Chinese: 导出组合模型前请先在设置中加载游戏资源库。

SetModels_ExportZero.Chinese: 没有可导出的组合模型。

SetModels_ExportManifest.Chinese: · 已生成分类清单 composition_manifest.json 与 .csv

SetModels_ZeroBasedHint.English: Domestic editors number .set sections from 0. Enable this to name cards and exported PNGs mir_0, mir_1, ... instead of mir_1, mir_2, ...
SetModels_ZeroBasedHint.Chinese: 国内编辑器从 0 开始编号。勾选后卡片名与导出 PNG 命名为 mir_0、mir_1……（默认 mir_1、mir_2……）

SetModels_ExportFramesHint.English: For compositions with animated lights, also write frame_00.png, frame_01.png ... into a <name>_frames folder.
SetModels_ExportFramesHint.Chinese: 含动态灯光的组合会额外在 <名称>_frames 文件夹中写出 frame_00.png、frame_01.png……

ExportClassicMapHint.English: Write the 52-byte header + 12-byte-per-cell layout that game clients, 996 servers and domestic editors can open.
ExportClassicMapHint.Chinese: 导出 52 字节头 + 12 字节/格的盛大原版格式，游戏客户端、996 服务端与国内编辑器均可打开。

ClassicMap_Preserve.Chinese: 保存时保留盛大原版 .map 格式

ClassicMap_PreserveHint.English: Keep Shanda/Wemade client maps readable by domestic editors and game servers. Turn off only when you need Crystal-only features.
ClassicMap_PreserveHint.Chinese: 保持盛大/Wemade 客户端地图可被国内编辑器与游戏服务端读取。仅在需要 Crystal 专有功能时关闭。

ClassicMap_Unsupported.English: This map uses features that a classic Mir2 .map cannot store
ClassicMap_Unsupported.Chinese: 当前地图包含盛大原版 .map 无法保存的内容（多层前景、贴图动画或素材库编号超过 255）。请在「设置」中关闭『保存时保留盛大原版 .map 格式』后再保存。
